services.name: Sail Now!
services.desc: Sail the Atlantic via the St Johns River - A full day on the water for those who crave adventure Our St. Johns River & Atlantic Coast Sail offers an unforgettable day-sail from the tranquil waters of the Intracoastal Waterway (ICW) to the wide-open Atlantic Ocean. Your adventure begins with a scenic cruise along the ICW, where you'll enjoy the natural beauty and wildlife of its winding banks. As we sail past Naval Station Mayport, you’ll have the rare opportunity to see impressive military vessels up close. blurb: Guests sail aboard S/V 'Kini's LegaSea, a Gemini Legacy 35 catamaran, for private coastal adventures tailored to couples, families, or groups. Cruises explore the Intracoastal Waterway and Atlantic coast near Jacksonville, with opportunities to see dolphins, manatees, and local wildlife. The crew includes a U.S. Coast Guard licensed captain and experienced sailing crew.
